styleLock.backgroundSystem: matte white bathtub rim in the foreground and mint-and-white vertical striped ceramic tile behind, seamless shallow depth, no other room context
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright 5500K top light slightly forward-left as key, large soft front-right fill, one soft-edged contact shadow under the product, airy mood with gentle mint bounce, no harsh specular hotspots
styleLock.surfaceSystem: smooth matte glazed ceramic (tub rim, tile, soap dish, pedestal) contrasted with soft cotton gauze weave; no wet floor, no water sheen on tile, no mirror
styleLock.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif in medium weight for all headings and labels, Chinese copy kept short inside 「」, #2D2D2D on light zones and #FFFFFF on mint zones, accent labels in #F0A05A
styleLock.iconSystem: honey-orange #F0A05A thin-line outline icons, 1.5px stroke, rounded caps, water-drop as the recurring motif, flat with no fill or gradient, max 3 icons per screen
styleLock.presentationRules: product centered on a stable scale across the set, the folded stack keeps honest gauze volume and never collapses into flat cloth, verticals stay vertical, one real scale anchor (ceramic soap dish, tray, pedestal, drying rail) in every scene shot, believable contact shadow so nothing floats
noDrift: no brand name, store name, logo, watermark, QR code or membership badge
no price, discount, coupon or delivery-time text
no weight, thread count, yarn count, cotton-percentage, size or dimension figures
no age range, certification, test report, award, lab or hospital endorsement
no antibacterial, hypoallergenic, fluorescent-agent-free or grade-tier claims
no origin, import or patent wording
no nude infant and no bathing process; a person appears only as a cropped forearm or hand, or not at all
no wet or slippery floor, no standing water, no splashing
fabric stays woven cotton gauze with a visible warp/weft grid and 3D bubble pucker; never flat sheeting, satin, paper or non-woven cloth
no palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no saturated blue-dominant grade
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh mint-and-white baby bath commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, pale mint #E4F3EE, mid mint #9FD3C7 and honey-orange accent #F0A05A; neutral 5500K bright top light with soft contact shadows and gentle mint bounce; consistent background system of a matte white bathtub rim and mint-and-white vertical striped ceramic tile; smooth matte glazed ceramic surfaces with soft cotton gauze texture; one modern geometric sans-serif with short Chinese copy in 「」; honey-orange thin-line outline icons with a water-drop motif; stable centered product scale and honest woven cotton gauze with a visible grid and 3D bubble pucker; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no wet or slippery floor, no nude infant and no bathing process.
